reading_rule: Consume each row as a premise or falsifier before proof search. A result implied by a row is dominated; use the stronger row and continue toward the three-prime parent theorem. Route choice remains unrestricted.

The infinite-tail specialization is closed; excluding the exact-integral-state branch, and its per-denominator generalization, is the precise unresolved throat.

results.exact_statement: If S = p/q then EVERY X_a lies on the (1/q)-lattice simultaneously, with an explicit integer witness; by pigeonhole on (1/q)Z/Z rationality forces two distinct scales a < b with X_b - X_a in Z (exists_normalizedTailState_collision_of_value_eq_rat). Additionally, for p in {2,3,5}, every smooth x < p^m satisfies p*H(x) | H(p^m) (smoothHeight_mul_prime_dvd_boundaryHeight): the same rational prefix clears at THREE families of prime-power boundaries, not only dyadic ones — the 3- and 5-boundary lattices are new and unexploited by any prior packet.

CORRECTED LOCAL LAW (research_packet.json negative_results[26]): b_a | d_a plus positivity does NOT force X_(a+1) = 0; the correct statement is X_a in Z iff b_a | X_(a+1), and X_(a+1) < b_a fails cofinally. results.exact_statement: X_m <= 40*(m+4)^3 for every m, by the exact depth-K pinning telescope (trueNormalizedState_eq_telescope) plus the proved quadratic digit majorant and the closed form of the poly-geometric series. With this width the forced-equality theorem becomes unconditional: an integer seed surviving all windows forever equals the true state (surviving_window_orbit_eq_true_state), and the companion seed-extinction census is cofinally decisive.

results.exact_statement: Under an integrality hypothesis X_A = w, the pinning telescope yields the exact identity X_(A+k) + N_k = w*B_k with N_0 = 0, N_(k+1) = b_(A+k)*N_k + d_(A+k), B_0 = 1, B_(k+1) = b_(A+k)*B_k, and M_k = prod_(j<=k) b_(A+j) >= 2^(k+1). The least residue of -(b_(A+k)*N_k + d_(A+k)) modulo M_k must equal the true state whenever that state fits inside (0, hi] with hi < M_k; a residue outside the enclosure refutes integrality at A. The modulus grows exponentially while the enclosure grows only cubically (40*(A+k+4)^3), so for each A all but boundedly many depths are refutation opportunities. The named missing piece is UNIFORMITY IN A (tracked in the module header as the uniform-depth target).
supersedes: bounded-lookahead delay caps and gap-descent Lyapunov candidates (all exactly falsified)
results.why_it_matters: This is the closest thing to one-lemma-away in the corpus: exponential modulus versus cubic width, missing only uniformity in the start index.

results.exact_statement: b_a = 2 * 3^[a in B(log2 3)] * 5^[a in B(log2 5)] where B(theta) is the Beatty set {floor(j*theta)}: the radix word is the coding of a rotation on the 2-torus by (log_3 2, log_5 2) under a product partition. Verified: 0 mismatches against the literal engine for a = 1..2600; radix frequencies match the independent-rotation prediction to five decimals over 300,000 letters; factor complexity is exactly (n+1)^2 for n = 1..22. The state lower bound X_a >= (1/60)*(floor(a/(2 log2 3))+1)*(floor(a/(2 log2 5))+1) grows quadratically, so no interval confinement exists for S (unlike the pure-power channels).
results.hypotheses: Identification is exact; the complexity and frequency rows are finite measurements.
supersedes: opaque-word functional searches (Lyapunov, coboundary, observer) on the source
results.why_it_matters: Puts the whole problem inside quasi-periodic dynamics of rank two, where equidistribution and complexity tools actually exist.

results.exact_statement: Sigma_p = sum_(m>=1) 1/H(p^m) is irrational for every channel p of every finite prime support with r >= 2 (elementary, unconditional; Lean module PurePowerIrrationality, four theorems, no sorry). The exact telescope sum_(p in {2,3,5}) (p-1)*Sigma_p = 1 makes the three channel values rationally dependent even though each is irrational. NOVELTY UNVERIFIED for r >= 3 — do not present as new without a prior-art pass (Cantor-series / Ostrowski literature); for r = 2 Hecke–Mahler gives more.
results.hypotheses: None; the proof is the small-nonzero-linear-form criterion with right-special radix factors.
supersedes: nothing about S itself — the single failing hypothesis is the all-ones digit sequence
results.why_it_matters: A genuine unconditional theorem in the family that isolates, in one line, exactly what makes S hard.

results.exact_statement: Under rationality S = p/q, the proper carry-normalized digit word eps_a = floor(b_a*{X_a}) satisfies P_eps(n) <= q*P_b(n) <= q*(n+1)^2 for every n, because the window (eps_a,...,eps_(a+n-1)) is a function of ({X_a}, b_a,...,b_(a+n-1)) and {X_a} takes at most q values while the radix word has complexity (n+1)^2. Contrapositive: SUPERQUADRATIC subword complexity of the proper digit word proves S irrational, and q >= P_eps(n)/(n+1)^2 for every n. Conjectured exact law (receipt): p_W(n) = sum over radix factors u in L_b(n) of prod(u), which would give P_eps(n)/(n+1)^2 >= 2^n; measured EXACTLY ATTAINED at n = 1, 2 (hit fraction 1.0), sample-limited at n = 3, 4.
results.hypotheses: The criterion is proved; the exact product law is conjectural with finite support.
supersedes: the retired Adamczewski–Bugeaud route, which measured the complexity of the RADIX word (Theta(n^2), useless)
results.why_it_matters: A proved irrationality criterion no prior packet has ever exposed, with a measured 2^n-sized target.

results.exact_statement: S = lim_(M->infty) [triple Fourier partial sum over |m_i| <= M] - 17/2, where each mode contributes c(m1)c'(m2)c''(m3) / [(1-e(lambda)/8)(1-e(lambda*theta)/27)(1-e(lambda*phi)/125)] with lambda = m1 + m2*log_3 2 + m3*log_5 2, c(m) = 1/(ln2 - 2*pi*i*m), c'(m) = 2/(ln3 - 2*pi*i*m), c''(m) = 4/(ln5 - 2*pi*i*m). The 17/2 correction is exact (8 at the origin plus an exact 1/2 from the three channel telescopes). Convergence is the 1/M jump rate, monotone in sign; the triple sum is only conditionally summable (sum |c c' c''| diverges like (log M)^3) and needs regularisation before any Diophantine estimate can be extracted.
results.hypotheses: Exact representation; NOT an irrationality argument.
supersedes: purely combinatorial value access; this is the first analytic representation of the value
results.why_it_matters: Every mode is governed by a linear form in logarithms of 2, 3, 5 — the same input the digit-side routes reduced to, visible in the value itself.

results.exact_statement: Rationality with denominator B coprime to 30 forces the shadow congruence d_a*H_b = d_b*H_a (mod B) across admissible window pairs (Lean-checked exact factorization; witnesses B = 11 with carries 61 and 259, B = 7). Measured abundance across all 133 denominators coprime to 30 in [7,500], starts a <= 3000: EVERY denominator admits violating pairs (violating fraction 0.828 at B = 7 up to 0.988 at B = 499); admissible endpoints appear at density about one per two starts and persist to the top of every range; same-start pairs are ALWAYS coherent (P = 1.0000), so any construction must pair different starts; far-separated pairs are equidistributed (coherence ratio 0.92x-1.23x).
results.hypotheses: The congruence is exact; the abundance rows are finite measurements, not the cofinal theorem.
supersedes: scarcity readings of the projective producer; the construction is abundant, only the proof is missing

results.exact_statement: The Adamczewski–Bugeaud stammering route is retired for the three-prime radix word: repetition exponents at record simultaneous-approximation denominators decay to 1 like 1 + O(q^(-1/2)); Dirichlet in dimension two caps simultaneous approximation at exponent 1/2 while the criterion needs 1 at the same denominator. The failure margin is a full power q^(1/2). The precise external input that would reopen ANY repetition-based lane is an effective bound max(||q*log_3 2||, ||q*log_5 2||) >> q^(-1+delta); current technology gives only exp(-C*(log B)^2) (Laurent–Mignotte–Nesterenko) and ||q*log_3 2|| >> q^(-4.117) (via Rhin).
results.hypotheses: Measured retirement plus the structural Dirichlet cap; the reopening bound is beyond current published technology.
supersedes: re-attempting repetition structure without a new two-log lower bound

Likewise the continued fraction of X_1 is Diophantine-generic (13,109 airtight-certified partial quotients, Gauss–Kuzmin frequencies, Levy constant within 0.18%, largest partial quotient 129,114): no Liouville-flavoured lever exists, and X_1 is not rational with denominator below 2^22482.
